body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> Acer(www.acer.com) introduced smartphone 'Metal' with Android 2.2(Froyo) at the International Consumer Electronics Show(CES) held at Las Vegas, USA, for 4 days from January 6.
<AVING Special Report Team for 2011 International CES: Ideak Kim, Kevin Choi, Joseph Choi, Paul Shin, Jun Lim, Daniel Kim, Ashley Kim, Sohpia Kwag, Mia Eun, Sena Moon, Jiny Kim, Astin Jung>
